Synopsis:
    China announced a comprehensive rural revitalisation funding plan targeting 2030, combining fiscal, credit, insurance, bond and private capital instruments to reinforce food security and rural modernisation. Key measures include priority budget allocations for agriculture, expanded bank lending to grain-producing counties, broader agricultural insurance for staple crops (rice, wheat, corn, soybeans), and encouragement of private capital via REITs and rural funds. Renewable energy partnerships on rural land are also promoted.
